messages:
Alex: Quick sync — we need a concise final checklist for Lighthouse prod entry. SLA, docs, support rota, monitoring alerts, and pricing/quotas signed off by EOD Friday. Who owns what?
Priya: I can own runtime + canary config. Question: do we hard-limit RPS for tier-1 customers during rollout or use throttling?
Matt: SRE: we need explicit SLOs to wire alerts. Proposed targets: p99 latency < 200ms, availability 99.9% for hosted. Can we commit? Also need a runbook for KV cache warmup fallback.
Sara: Support: need a 2-week on-call overlap for the first two weeks post-launch. Who provides rotation and escalation path?
Jules: Finance: I need the final pricing buckets and estimated per-token unit cost to approve billing docs. Is there a spreadsheet with cost assumptions?
Dan: Docs: I'll draft quickstart + rollback steps + known-limits page. Need exact API error codes and recommended retry/backoff to include. ETA: Tue EOD if you hand off details today.
Priya: For throttling: suggest soft-throttle at 90% of observed baseline during canary, hard caps only if queue depth > X. I'll add config snippet to the rollout plan.
Matt: Adding runbook bullets: 1) Detect elevated tail latency, 2) failover to smaller quantized variant, 3) notify oncall channel, 4) rollback canary. Also need automated smoke tests for KV cache priming.
Alex: Good. Assigning owners: SLA/SLO owner = Matt; Canary + runtime = Priya; Support rota = Sara; Pricing/public docs = Jules; Customer-facing docs = Dan.
Sara: On rota: I'll recruit 1x Support TL + 2x SME for the two-week overlap. Put oncall handoff doc in /confluence/launches/lighthouse. Also need training notes for common errors.
Jules: I've started a cost model: https://redwood.internal/sheets/lighthouse-costs (private). Notes: expected 20% uplift in peak GPU hours w/ current batching. Need engineering to confirm batching defaults.
Priya: Batching defaults are in the runtime config. I'll expose a recommended profile for Lighthouse and link it in Dan's docs.
Dan: For rollback steps, can you paste the exact CLI we should document? e.g.:
```
redwood deploy rollback --release lighthouse-canary --to stable-2026-03-01
```
Is that accurate?
Priya: That looks right, minor flag name change: `--to-revision stable-2026-03-01`. Will confirm.
Matt: Monitoring thresholds to include in docs: token-error-rate > 0.5% for 5m, p99 latency > 250ms for 5m, GPU mem pressure > 85% for 3m. Those trigger pager.
Alex: Good. Two admin asks: 1) Compliance — any regulatory blockers for private customers? 2) Support SLAs — do we need 24/7 for tier-1 on day one?
Jules: Compliance: no new blockers for hosted; Private customers may require extra audit logs — include as opt-in add-on.
Sara: Support SLA: recommend 24/7 only for enterprise customers who purchase that add-on. We'll cover standard business-hours for self-serve on day one.
Matt: One more: add a synthetic user journey test that runs every 2m and posts metrics to the launch dashboard. I can add the Grafana panels if Dan gives me the metric names.
Dan: Metric names: `lighthouse.request.latency`, `lighthouse.request.errors`, `lighthouse.kv.cache_hit_rate`. I'll add to docs and dashboards section.
Alex: Action items summary (everyone please ack):
- Matt: finalize SLO doc + runbook (due Wed)
- Priya: canary config + rollback CLI confirmation (due Tue)
- Dan: quickstart, rollback steps, and dashboard links (due Tue EOD)
- Sara: oncall roster + training notes (due Wed)
- Jules: finalize pricing buckets & cost assumptions (due Wed)
- Alex: coordinate external launch comms and approval package (due Thu)

Please react with :white_check_mark: when you own the task or reply with blockers. deploy-bot: scheduled deploy check?
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline green for staging. All e2e smoke tests passed. Build id: build-2026-03-09-1123.
Priya: acked :white_check_mark:, will upload canary config to the runbook by EOD today.
Matt: acked :white_check_mark: — will share SLO PR for review by noon tomorrow.
Dan: acked :white_check_mark: — starting docs now.
Sara: acked :white_check_mark:, adding support runbook and shift schedule.
Jules: acked :white_check_mark:, I'll push final numbers and notes to the sheet by Wed morning.
Alex: Thanks team — we'll reconvene Thu 11am for final sign-off. If anything slips, ping here. :rocket:
